DIAGNOSIS READY: Stable Angina Pectoris due to Coronary Artery Disease.

Given the classic description of exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw and arm, relieved by rest, alongside diaphoresis and dyspnea, this is highly suggestive of myocardial ischemia.
